referenceNotes: Public coefficient values are now preserved exactly; no payout calibration multiplier is applied. Independent probabilities and public-rule fidelity are under review; launching is disabled.
Runtime win display multiplies coefficients by betPerLine; line-stake basis follows this display and public rules despite WinsOnLine:false in the bootstrap.
Only listed fixed demo stake amounts are accepted. Demo currency is DMO; no claim is made that its numerical limits are a provider-approved ETB profile.

Removed the invented global10,000 ceiling and Burning100×cap. Uses the title-specific reference maximum numerically; any displayed multiplier maximum remains a conservative draft ceiling, with exact truncation-versus-outcome-support semantics unverified.
rules: Fixed demo-derived stake schedule 0.05–400.00 and numerical maximum payout 58000.00. Source currency is DMO; isolated draft maps the numbers1:1 into ETB. Production remains disabled.

Highest eligible left-to-right award per line; simultaneous line wins add. The public reference maximum is used as a draft payout ceiling. Whether the source enforces that maximum by truncation or by restricting reachable outcomes remains under review.
All results resolve on the server in one accepted round. Automatic features never require an extra debit.
Every symbol is equally likely in each independent grid cell. The independent 1×, 2×, 3×, 4× and 5× multipliers are equally likely.
Safari expansion is visual: a full zebra, elephant or tiger first reel and matching subsequent full reels expand without adding payouts.

Fractional santim are rounded once for the total win without bias: the same committed server RNG pays either the lower or upper whole santim in proportion to the fractional part. The difference is at most one santim, and every result stays within the cap.
This model is disabled pending official-demo public-rule parity and independent sampling calibration. Prior adaptation features and limits are not an approved faithful release.
Official help states a maximum of 145× the stake. The disabled draft uses that numerical ceiling; the private outcome restrictions that produce the source maximum are not known.

math.description: Raw public coefficients and exact numerical demo stakes are preserved. This disabled draft uses an independent, uncalibrated outcome distribution. Exact uncapped enumeration and a50,000-round seeded pilot are recorded as diagnostics, not provider RTP or a release guarantee. Displayed numerical reference maxima are used as draft ceilings; source truncation-versus-reachable-outcome semantics remain unverified where they matter.

rounding.rng: Same committed server RNG stream, after every outcome/feature draw. No global randomness.
rounding.rule: For exact fractional payout n+r santim, pay n+1 with probability r and n otherwise. Exact integers and already capped payouts require no rounding draw.
rounding.reserve: Outcome-independent maximum is rounded UP before applying the published caps.
rounding.scope: Applied once to the whole round; credited line/frame payouts sum exactly to that result.

analyticBeforeReferenceMaximum.method: Exact enumeration of every symbol sequence on one path; linearity across actual lines/ways and independent mean multiplier3. No cap or outcome-support claim.

pilot.scope: Uncalibrated disabled draft; confidence approximation is diagnostic, not certification. Same return applies to every listed stake because raw payouts are integral and maxima scale proportionally or remain above the raw model bound.

releaseGate.reason: Raw coefficients, exact schedules and numerical reference maxima are aligned. Public controls/presentation, source maximum semantics and Burning respin rules remain incomplete; independent probabilities are uncalibrated.

currencyAdaptation.method: Numerical 1:1 mapping of demo values only; not an exchange rate or provider-approved ETB profile.
